title: Towards Explainable Harmful Meme Detection through Multimodal Debate between Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis identifying the model's acquired tendency to falsely classify benign content featuring Muslims as harmful due to training data exposure.
Qualitative evaluation of the LLM's ability to generate reasoning for racism-related memes, noting limitations in accurately recognizing skin color in certain images.
Error analysis assessing the model's failure to recognize implicit textual slurs (e.g., 'potato') used to target and mock individuals with intellectual disabilities.
Error analysis evaluating the model's detection of memes that dehumanize women using misogynistic domestic stereotypes.
Qualitative evaluation of the model's generated rationales regarding offensiveness and hatefulness directed at the LGBT+ community.
